steps.action: Lay the two 1x6 plates on top of the walls, one along the back long edge and one along the front long edge, framing the open centre.
watch_for: Keep the plates flush with the outer edges of the wall so the inner opening above the red part stays clear
Align both plates on the long sides, not the short ends

steps.action: Place the two 2x4 gray plates end to end across the top, bridging the opening behind the red part to form a 2x8 strip along the long side.
watch_for: Leave the front opening over the red part uncovered
Make sure the plates span both side walls and press down on the studs at each end
